overview_description.description: ACV operates an online marketplace for dealer car auctions, connecting buyers and sellers of wholesale used vehicles. Its platform provides vehicle listings, inspections, bidding, pricing data, transportation, inventory management, and vehicle financing services. Dealers can buy and sell vehicles online while accessing vehicle condition reports and wholesale market information.

product.name: ACV Auctions Online Marketplace
product.description: A dealer-only, cloud-based marketplace for buying and selling used vehicles through online auctions, fixed-price listings, and no-reserve sales.

identifier.value: ACV Vehicle Inspection and Condition Reports

product.name: ACV Vehicle Inspection and Condition Reports
product.description: On-site vehicle inspection and digital condition-reporting services that document a vehicle’s mechanical and cosmetic condition for online wholesale transactions.

product.name: ACV Pro
product.description: A dealer-facing inspection and listing application that enables authorized dealers to inspect vehicles and launch them to the ACV marketplace.

product.name: ACV Estimate and Market Report
product.description: A wholesale vehicle valuation and market-pricing tool that uses current auction data to help dealers estimate values and set bids or sale prices.

product.name: ACV Capital
product.description: A dealer financing and floor-planning service that helps qualified dealers fund used-vehicle inventory purchases through transparent financing arrangements.

product.name: ACV Transportation
product.description: A managed vehicle-shipping service for dealers that coordinates open or enclosed transport, carrier assignment, delivery tracking, and related logistics across the United States.
